description_en: Queries the information about a lock-waiting query for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例锁等待详情信息
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-waiting-sql-info --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --pid 100 --database test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWaitingSQLInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the process that uniquely identifies the query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461735.html operation to obtain the process IDs of lock-waiting queries
parameters.help_zh:
进程ID，即等待查询SQL的唯一标识。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461735.html接口获取锁等待的查询的进程ID
parameters.name: pid
